repo_prior_art.cite: scm_shapley_sharedcoupling_bounds_v1, thm:sharp-shared-interval, already establishes attained exact shared-coupling endpoints.

repo_prior_art.cite: No in-catalogue run proves a long-record stationary-response ambiguity contraction result.

LallyKazemiPaoletti2026RobustCounterfactualMDP gives one-transition bounds and HaughSingal2023DynamicLatent gives finite-horizon dynamic bounds, but neither gives this full-support stationary-feedback root-T lower-rate witness.

novelty_flags.label: thm:exact-endpoints
novelty_flags.one_line: Generic tight finite canonical-SCM polynomial optimization is already supplied by ZhangTianBareinboim2022PartialCounterfactual; this endpoint theorem is a specialization, not an independently novel kernel.

soundness_flags.label: Symbols e, Q_{q,T}, I_T(P,e), D_T(P,e), and all “P-positive evidence” qualifiers
soundness_flags.one_line: P is only a controlled transition kernel, so Pr_P(E_T=e) is not defined without the induced factual law from rho, b, and o; define that law and carry its arguments in the positivity and interval notation.

soundness_flags.label: lem:coarsening-domination and lem:poisson-martingale
soundness_flags.one_line: Q_{q,T} and D_T are defined only for coarsened evidence e in O^(T+1), but these statements evaluate them at the full state path X_{0:T}; introduce explicitly defined full-record functionals Q^full, I^full, and D^full before using the coarsening comparison or Poisson identity.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:root-t-width
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The whole-polytope maximal inequality is assumed as the displayed premise and is not claimed proved by this theorem.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Conditional only: if the stated uniform maximal inequality holds, then the repaired expected-width functional is bounded by 1024B d^(dk)/(epsilon sqrt(T)); Stage 0 must decide the preceding synchronizer-square dichotomy.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 3-4, Theorem 2.4, Proposition 2.5, Eq. (9), and Theorem 2.8
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper reduces finite discrete counterfactual bounds to polynomial optimization over canonical SCMs and states that the resulting program gives tight bounds.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 45-49, Lemma 67 and proofs of Theorems 17-18
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper rewrites cumulative reward for a fixed policy using a Poisson-equation martingale decomposition and applies bounded martingale-difference concentration.
The paper conditions on an individual record and optimizes a polynomial counterfactual objective over feasible joint dependence variables with fixed marginals.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv v5, cited alongside the AAMAS 2026 entry
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The source derives exact closed-form bounds for counterfactual transition probabilities following one observed transition.
The paper defines counterfactual stability, proves the Gumbel-Max SCM satisfies it, and uses the selected SCM for counterfactual trajectory generation.

source_verification_receipts.version: Econometrica 87 (2019), version of record landing page
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper develops calibrated-projection confidence intervals for partially identified parameter projections and studies their statistical and computational performance.
The paper relates uniform martingale laws to sequential Rademacher complexity and a Dudley-type sequential covering integral.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Define the induced factual law P^fac_{rho,b,o}, then replace every P-positive qualifier and every interval argument by notation that distinguishes coarsened evidence from a full factual path.

Demote thm:exact-endpoints to infrastructure, or replace it with a strict stationary-versus-rectangular comparison on a common published model class and an explicit witness where their endpoints differ.

Make the synchronizer-square dichotomy the sole headline solve target and state a concrete chaining or horizon-dependent lower-selection route whose resolution transfers to the whole-polytope rate frontier.

recommended_next_step: Repair the two evidence-domain defects, demote the generic endpoint program from the novelty kernel, and then advance the synchronizer-square rate dichotomy to Stage 0.
